Do not change the input documents. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption, list your assumptions in your final message, and finish the work.

rubric.criterion: Computes the sprint 15 capacity as 27 points from three people at 10 points each minus 3 days of leave (RS1) and gives the new due dates by adding the sprint length (RS2).
States that the board will show 22 of 27 points after the rollover, because the recreated T-103 has no points (RS3).
States that the real load is 27 of 27 points, so the sprint is exactly full (RS4, RS7).
Says that the rollover recreates the tasks and loses the subtasks of T-103 and the 5 points on them, and also comments, attachments, followers and tags (RS5).
Tells the team to get confirmation before the rollover and to recreate the subtasks or move their points to the new task afterwards (RS6). Makes no false claim that the subtasks come along.
